entries.def:
πειθαρχέω, -ῶ
(πείθομαι, ἀρχή) [in LXX: Dan LXX 7:27 (שְׁמַע), Sir.33.28, I Est.8.94 * ;] 
to obey one in authority, be obedient: Tit.3.1 with dative, Act.27.21 θεῷ, Act.5.29, 32.†
(AS)

πειθός (πιθός, WH), -ή, -όν 
(πείθω), = cl. πιθανός, 
persuasive: 1Co.2.4 (not found elsewhere).†
(AS)

πείθω, 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח בֶּטַח, its parts and derivatives ;] 
__(i) Active; 
__1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., Mat.28.14, Act.19.26 before περί, with genitive of thing(s), Act.19.8 with accusative of person(s), Act.12.20; 14.19; 18.4, 2Co.5.11, Gal.1.10; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, 1Jn.3.19 with accusative before περί, Act.28.23…

πεῖρα, -ας, ἡ
(πειράω), [in LXX: Deu.28.56 (π. λαμβάνειν, נָסָה pi.) Deu.33.8 (מַסָּה), Wis.18.20, 25, 2Ma.8.9, 4Ma.8.1 * ;] 
trial, experiment; π. λαμβάνειν, to make trial, have experience of: Heb.11.29, 36 (for exx., see Field, Notes, 232 f.).†
(AS)

πειράζω poët. and late prose form of πειράω, which see, 
[in LXX for נָסָה pi. ;] 
__1. to make proof of (Hom.). 
__2. to try, attempt (Luc., Polyb., with inf. (see M, Pr., 205; B1., § 69, 4), Act.9.26; 16.7; 24.6. 
__3. In LXX and NT, like Heb. נָסָה, with accusative of person(s), to test, try, prove; 
__(a) in a good sense : Jhn.6.6, 2Co.13.5, Heb.11.17, Rev.2.2; esp. of trials and af6ictions sent or permitted by…

πειρασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(πειράζω), [in LXX for מַסָּה, עִנְיָן ;] 
__1. = πεῖρα, an experiment Diosc.). 
__2. a trial, of ethical purpose and effect, whether good or evil (see Hort on Jas.1.13) 
__(a) in good or neutral sense: Gal.4.14, Jas.1.12, 1Pe.4.12; esp. of afflictions sent by God (Deu.7.19, Sir.21.1-28, al.): 2Pe.2.9, Rev.3.10; pl., Luk.22.28, Act.20.19, Jas.1.2, 1Pe.1.6; 
__(b) of trial regarded as leading to…

πέλαγος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX: 2Ma.5.21, 4Ma.7.1 * ;] 
the deep sea, the deep, the sea: Act.27.5 τὸ π. τῆς θαλάσσης, Mat.18.6 
SYN.: θαλάσσα (which see); and cf. ἄβυσσος (AS)
